tasks.label: Inspect Git repository state
tasks.command: git status --short; git remote -v; git branch --show-current; git check-ignore -v .env; git ls-files .env

tasks.label: Upload AI Recruiter to GitHub
tasks.command: git init; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { exit $LASTEXITCODE }; git branch -M main; git remote remove origin 2>$null; git remote add origin https://github.com/Bharath-hax/AI-Recruiter.git; git check-ignore -v .env; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { Write-Error '.env is not ignored'; exit 1 }; git add .; git diff --cached --name-only; if (git diff --cached --name-only | Select-String -SimpleMatch '.env') { Write-Error '.env is staged'; exit 1 }; git commit -m "Initial commit: AI Recruiter platform`n`nCo-authored-by: Copilot <223556219+Copilot@users.noreply.github.com>"; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { exit $LASTEXITCODE }; git push -u origin main

tasks.label: Commit and push AI Recruiter
tasks.command: git init; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { exit $LASTEXITCODE }; git branch -M main; git remote remove origin 2>$null; git remote add origin https://github.com/Bharath-hax/AI-Recruiter.git; git check-ignore -v .env; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { Write-Error '.env is not ignored'; exit 1 }; git add .; $staged = git diff --cached --name-only; $staged; if ($staged | Select-String -SimpleMatch '.env') { Write-Error '.env is staged'; exit 1 }; git commit -m 'Initial commit: AI Recruiter platform' -m ('Co-authored-by: Copilot ' + [char]60 + '223556219+Copilot@users.noreply.github.com' + [char]62); if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { exit $LASTEXITCODE }; git push -u origin main
